newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine vampire bat plague kills cattle, worker.
newsitem.headline: Argentine vampire bat plague kills cattle, worker.

text.p: Rabies-infected vampire bats have killed 10,000 cattle and a farm labourer in the northern Argentine province of Chaco, a newspaper reported on Monday.

Chaco has offered a reward of $20 per vampire bat nest discovered so the nests and offspring can be destroyed, Clarin newspaper said. Vampire, which drink the blood of sleeping animals, do not normally attack people, but 28-year-old farm labourer Feliciano Lopez died of rabies after being bitten in January.
Vampire bats have spread closer than usual to towns in subtropical northern Argentine since floods at the beginning of the year.
